rows.coordinatorObservation: Complete dark view: response fractions 40/80 and 12/20, 4/20 and 24/80; composition bars 80/20 versus 20/80; pooled 44/100 versus 36/100. Footer rejects superiority. All panels visible.
Complete light view: same two within-category comparisons and composition bars; overall 44 versus 36 is a reversal with explicit confounding and no-superiority limits. No clipped labels observed.

Complete dark view: two 100-person groups have 80/20 and 20/80 compositions, equal 75 percent and 25 percent within-category rates, pooled 65 and 35, and a common six-week symptom clock. Adjustment limits visible.
Complete light view: same 65/35 observational mixture arithmetic and common six-week clock; all four panels and causal/adjustment cautions visible. Distinct from the 44/36 shared example.

Complete dark view: vehicle, positive, independent-mechanism and restoration controls ask separate questions. The invented 100/200/100 count example does not measure death fraction. Footer retains context and no-single-control limits.

Complete light view: same four control questions and direct-count example; all labels and caution panel visible. The well symbols do not supply actual measured cell counts or a universal assay protocol.

Complete dark forest view: five equal squares and 20 percent weights, mean -4 with separate narrow mean interval and wider -13 to +5 prediction line, no-effect zero, I-squared and tau-squared units, and few-study/approximation cautions visible.

Complete light forest view: all five study estimates and equal weights are visible; mean confidence diamond and prediction line use the same linear score-point axis. No observed label clipping; no direction-of-benefit or individual prognosis inferred.

Complete dark view: dated primary EFS and exploratory subgroup precede result access; all twelve later cutoff marks are present, with the sixth selected hypothetically. Future independent testing and planned-exploratory limits remain explicit; no numerical p-values supplied.

Complete light view: same ordering and twelve schematic cutoffs with selected sixth mark. Labels fit. Selection is distinguished by colour without an additional shape cue; colour-vision and nontext contrast acceptance are not established.

Complete dark view: phase purpose is separated from participant assignment; concealment concerns the next allocation, blinding is optional after assignment, and symbolic equal groups provide no sample-size or efficacy guarantee. All panels visible.
Complete light view: same separated purpose and concealed assignment pathway, with feasible blinding after allocation and clear limitations. Symbol counts are illustrative; no observed text clipping.

Complete uncropped 600 by 1740 dark view: two donor panels, six distinct wells per donor, each with its own count-not-given observation box. Footer states within-donor randomization, separate treatment, no interference and donor-nested analysis. No invented cell counts or effects.

Complete uncropped light hierarchy view: all A1-A6 and B1-B6 wells and nested observation groups remain distinct; no cell counts supplied. Conditional assignment and donor-breadth limits are legible at the bottom. Source imagery remains unchanged.

Complete dark view: one fictional randomized AB-BA symptom order with repeated same-measure observations is separate from A/procedure/B history. Hatched ribbons are labelled possible and unmeasured; no elapsed durations or causal contributions supplied. Right scan label is close to the edge but fully visible.

Complete light view: same fictional AB-BA repeated-period design and separately unmeasured A/procedure/B overlap at an improved scan. All labels remain visible, with a tight right margin at the scan label. No time durations, washout interval, treatment effects or care instructions inferred.
